external_collaboration.partner_name: Chevron’s Bay Area Black Employee Network
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: As part of the Reparations | Power | Healing Summit—coordinated by the Brotherhood of Elders Network, San Francisco Foundation (SFF), and East Bay Community Foundation—we hosted a volunteer activation at PRC’s Odyssey House. Alongside volunteers from Chevron’s Bay Area Black Employee Network and our partners at SFF, we spent the day revitalizing this historic recovery program that provides permanent housing to Black adults who were formerly incarcerated and/or unhoused.
